ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee (rider no-show confirmed by GPS and "I'm Here" record); no refund due.

rejected_claims.reason: No policy grants a grace period for rain; NS-4's 3-minute free-cancellation window applies only to rider-side cancellations, and NS-8 (ETA-based waiver) is informational only and not citable. The >3-minute wait and GPS-confirmed arrival satisfy NS-1.
